The remainder team in the landscape analysis now only collects active unmatched contributors. The codeanalyzer module builds and all 330 of its tests pass (3 skipped, none failing). I did not add a new test for this path.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`:

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

Configured teams are unchanged: the matching branch above it still adds every matched member, active or not. A blank latest-commit date already counts as active in `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so those contributors stay in the remainder. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped, and nothing is committed.
